p: king's heart is in the hand: Though kings seem to have all things at commandment, they are not able to bring their own purposes to pass unless God has appointed: much less are the inferiors able.
plowing of the wicked: That is, the thing by which he is guided or which he brings forth as the fruit of his work.
every one that is hasty only: He who goes rashly about his business and without counsel.
robbery of the wicked shall destroy: He means this chiefly of judges and princes who leave that calling, to which God has called them, and impoverish their subjects to maintain their lusts.
When the scorner is punished: Read Pr 19:25.
considereth the house of the wicked: Though the godly admonish them both by words and example of life, yet the wicked will not amend, till God destroys them.
gift in secret pacifieth anger: To do a pleasure to the angry man pacifies him.
wicked shall be a ransom for: God will cause that to fall on their own heads, which they intended against the just by delivering the just, and putting the wicked in their places.
oil in the dwelling of the: Meaning, abundance of all things.
wise man scaleth the city of: Wisdom overcomes strength and confidence in worldly things.
killeth him: He thinks to live by wishing and desiring all things, but will make no effort to get anything.
speaketh constantly: He may boldly testify the truth that he has heard.
